stemMd: A sphere of radius 3 cm is melted and recast without loss into small spheres of radius 1 cm. How many small spheres are formed?
explanationMd: Sphere volume is proportional to radius cubed. The large-to-small volume ratio is 3³/1³ = 27. Conservation of material volume therefore gives twenty-seven small spheres, assuming no loss.

distractorRationale.a: This uses the radius ratio rather than the volume ratio.
distractorRationale.c: This does not follow the cubic volume relation.
